task_description: Implement GitHub Issue #18: let fans mark MLB teams as favorites (persisted to localStorage, multiple allowed), highlight a favorite team's path through the bracket with a non-color-only cue plus a pinned header status, switch to an 'Eliminated'/'敗退' indication when a favorite loses a final series, and add a filter to show only favorite teams' series. Frontend-only (plus graded spec/README docs). EN/JA throughout and accessible. Branch feat/mlb-postseason-site; incremental commits; no push/PR/deploy (orchestrator owns publishing).

review.non_blocking_notes: Dead i18n key favorites.header.status.inProgress; imprecise between-rounds 'starts soon' status; favorites-filter button nested in refresh-bar testid. All cosmetic, none blocking.

verification.summary: Ordered npm run build passes. npm test: shared 34, backend 94, frontend 166, infra 8 all pass. npm run synth passes (CDK nodejs20.x deprecation warnings pre-existing). npm run test:e2e -w frontend: 42 passed incl. favorites.spec.ts. Test quality verified: bracketLayout helper tests assert eliminated/champion/in-progress/not-in-bracket outcomes that would fail if logic reverted; e2e asserts the non-color marker class + visually-hidden label, the active vs 敗退 pin status, the favorites-only filter, and the localized empty state. No Dockerfile build run (frontend-only change). #22 keyboard model and #17/#20 UI unregressed (their tests still green).
